paragraphs: Speridian Technologies is a consulting and technology services firm that works with enterprises and public sector organizations on modernizing operations and digital transformation. The work spans advisory, implementation, and managed services, with capabilities in AI, automation, cloud, analytics, and enterprise platforms. Featured offerings listed on the site include AI enablement, application modernization, cloud infrastructure, customer experience solutions, digital services, and lending and mortgage services.

CaseXellence is a process automation platform serving government, housing, education, and child welfare sectors. It handles benefits assistance, grant management, workers compensation, and license and permitting workflows. Beacon is a banking suite covering core banking, loan management, loan origination, credit monitoring, collections, analytics, and financial inclusion.

Speridian describes itself as an information technology consulting and services company that helps clients modernize their businesses through digital transformation. Certifications named on the about page include ISO 9001 for quality management, ISO 27001 for information security management, and CMMI.
